description.text: Pokémon Card Game Classic, a premium box made with the design office nendo to be played for good with only its three decks, Venusaur & Lugia ex, Charizard & Ho-Oh ex and Blastoise & Suicune ex. Its cards carry no regulation mark, so cards from every era can share a deck, and apart from basic Energy they can't be used in official tournaments. Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise use the illustrations of the first expansion of 1996 and keep their Energy Trans, Energy Burn and Rain Dance powers, now as Abilities, while the three Pokémon ex and a Pokémon Tool for each deck are new. This set is the Venusaur & Lugia ex deck: Venusaur's Energy Trans moves Grass Energy between your Pokémon as often as you like, to feed Lugia ex's costly attack, and the new Tool Sun Seed adds 100 damage to Venusaur's attack. The cloth-covered folding playmat holds the three decks and a toolbox of stackable damage counters, raised Poison and Burn markers and metal orbs that replace the coin: an orb rolled down its spiral that lands in a white-ringed hole counts as heads. In Japan, Pokémon Center Online and nendo house took lottery orders from 28 February to 10 March 2023, for shipping from late October 2023; it was also sold in English, Korean and Traditional Chinese.
